events.title: 79th Leadville Ski Joring — Free Spectator Weekend
events.time: 12:00 noon open division daily; sport ~1:30 PM, novice ~3:30 PM; Saturday kids event ~5:00 PM MST
events.location: Historic Harrison Avenue, downtown Leadville, CO 80461
events.cost: Free public spectator admission; 5 spectators $0; transport/food separate
events.age: Public spectators of all ages; no stated age restriction; children's participation age/fee not specified
events.description: Rare Western winter competition: horses pull skiers over jumps and through gates. Official https://www.leadvilleskijoring.com/ confirms 79th annual March 6–7, 2027; spectator schedule confirms free admission and daily competition starting noon. No spectator reservation indicated; street parking, no dogs or drones. Saturday children’s snowmobile-pulled skijoring is listed, with on-site registration and parental waiver (https://www.leadvilleskijoring.com/competitors); age/equipment/fee not verified, so only spectator opportunity recommended. Westminster city-to-city road distance about 102 miles; not a routine sports fixture. Before late June 2027 arrival, suitable for current Colorado residents.

events.title: 36th International Snow Sculpture Championships — Live Carving and Free Outdoor Exhibition
events.time: Live carving Jan 23 10 AM–Jan 27 9 AM; viewing Jan 27 9 AM–Feb 2 10 PM MST; illuminated until 10 PM nightly
events.location: Breckenridge Riverwalk Center, 150 West Adams Avenue, Breckenridge, CO
events.cost: Free public viewing; 5 people $0; free offsite parking/shuttle options; downtown parking and food extra
events.age: General public, all ages; no stated age restrictions
events.description: International teams hand-carve 25-ton snow blocks during nearly 100 hours of live sculpting; public can watch the rare process and see illuminated finished sculptures. Official tourism organizer confirms dates, free public entry, no Saturday reservation required, and live carving schedule. Team registration closed; this is spectator viewing, not hands-on carving. Weather may shorten display. Westminster city-to-city road distance about 83 miles. Before late June 2027 arrival; suitable for current Colorado residents.
